Description: Seccubus is a tool that helps reduce the time required to perform repeated vulnerability assessments on the same infrastructure. It is a wrapper around the following tools: NessusOpenVASNmapNiktoMedusaQualys SSL labsSSLyzeSkipfishZAPtestssl.shBurp All findings are translated to the Intermediary Vulnerability Information Language (IVIL) and imported into a database. After import findings are marked as either NEW, CHANGED, OPEN, NO ISSUE, GONE or MASKED to reduce the time required for subsequent analysis.
